ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels (~80%) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters (~20%) representing scarring and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters concentrated at the distal tips; distinct circular ring formations (10-50 pixel diameter) in the central-medial regions; dense white linear streaks extending across the lateral lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees and a depth of approximately 50-60 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern with pixel amplitudes of 5-25 pixels; multiple sharp peaks and irregular valleys along the entire continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by a concave transition from the median notch followed by a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible circular and annular white scars (barnacle attachment points) clustered primarily around the notch and central fluke areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear markings (rake marks) ranging from 20 to 300 pixels in length, distributed across the visible ventral surface, particularly dense on the outer lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including rake marks, circular parasitic/barnacle scars, and large amorphous white patches at the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced rough, textured accumulations at the extreme distal tips, likely indicating active or former barnacle colonization.
